__baseline_prompt__.text: A photograph of a mecha subject: a mechanical structure with an open-front cockpit above two compact articulated walking legs, parked in a quiet outdoor proving yard. In the frame, the mechanical subject is visibly present as a substantial working machine with joints, overlapping plates and worn load-bearing feet. A pilot sits in the cockpit, pausing over a folded route map before setting off. Use the supplied portrait as the pilot's facial and hair appearance reference. Preserve brown eyes and softly rounded facial contours, with a short dark brown bob, wispy separated bangs. Her face has a calm, concentrated presence in the soft daylight. The pilot rests her anatomical LEFT forearm along the left cockpit sill; her anatomical RIGHT hand lies flat on the paper route map. The map rests on her right thigh. The left cockpit sill is a broad horizontal support under the full left forearm. The paper route map shows a route line across its paper surface. The folded sheet has visible paper edges beneath her palm. Seen from the front, her left forearm and sill are on image right, while her right hand, map and right thigh are on image left. Her shoulders, elbows, wrists and fingers form relaxed, traceable chains. The seat supports her pelvis and back, and both boot soles are planted on the shallow open-front cockpit floor, with their sole-to-floor contacts exposed below her knees. The machine's two walking legs are separated in projection from hip joints through knees and ankles to two broad feet resting flat on the yard surface. A low front rim keeps the pilot's boot contacts in view. Frame the complete compact machine at a mild front three-quarter angle, including the pilot's face, both arm contacts, the cockpit floor, both complete machine legs and both ground contacts together, with a small margin of ground below the feet. Let a 50mm-equivalent photographic view, clear midtone daylight and deep usable focus make the human pause and the machine's weight equally tangible. Her practical sand-colored work suit and the machine's pale worn metal belong to the same restrained, credible field scene.
